Messages.Author: Randi S. Herdman
Messages.Body:
Hey, a couple rules questions that cropped up last night:

1. Rictor had the Sword of Judgement and Bang Nakh. Could he use the additional strike from the
Sword but do the strike with Bang Nakh (or something else)? The card (and the errata) seem to
just say that the Sword gives an additional strike.

2. Could Rictor play an additional additional strike?

3. Has Rumors of Gehenna been reworded to say, "each named methuselah gains an additional master
phase action" instead of in Jyhad "each named methuselah can play an additional master card"
(that's not the exact wording obviously).

That's all. Thanks!

Neil Paananen
ArchFiend of Denver

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
In article <7gafdq$s...@dfw-ixnews11.ix.netcom.com>,

Randi S. Herdman <ran...@ix.netcom.com> wrote:
> Hey, a couple rules questions that cropped up last night:
>
> 1. Rictor had the Sword of Judgement and Bang Nakh. Could he use the
additional strike from the
> Sword but do the strike with Bang Nakh (or something else)? The card (and the
errata) seem to
> just say that the Sword gives an additional strike.

Yes.

> 2. Could Rictor play an additional additional strike?

No. Only one card/effect can be used to gain additional strike(s) each round.

> 3. Has Rumors of Gehenna been reworded to say, "each named methuselah gains an
additional master
> phase action" instead of in Jyhad "each named methuselah can play an
additional master card"
> (that's not the exact wording obviously).

No. It still sets the number to "2" - it doesn't provide "additions".
Card text (V:TES):

Choose a set of Methuselahs. Successful vote means each chosen Methuselah
receives 2 master phase actions during his or her master phase (instead of
1). Any vampire can burn this card with a successful vote; calling this vote
is a +1 stealth action.
